subject.title: [Bug]: CLI relay exits silently with code 1 when session lane is blocked — no timeout or busy error surfaced

question: For a same-session CLI dispatch behind active lane work, should the supported contract be a terminal busy result with structured stderr/JSON and a chosen exit code, or should the CLI keep waiting and only improve timeout/error text?
rationale: The bug is real, but the candidate fix changes operator-visible behavior for blocked CLI dispatches and the issue discussion already left the exit-code and busy-versus-wait contract open.

options.title: Accept terminal busy result
options.body: Land or refine the linked PR so CLI callers receive `LANE_WAIT_EXCEEDED` details and a maintainer-approved exit code while non-CLI calls keep the existing queue behavior.

options.title: Preserve wait behavior
options.body: Implement only clearer timeout stderr/JSON for the existing wait path and avoid adding a terminal busy rejection contract for CLI dispatches.

options.title: Replace with narrower PR
options.body: Close or supersede the current candidate only after opening a smaller PR that keeps the agreed contract and drops any unnecessary protocol churn.

recommendation.title: Accept terminal busy result
recommendation.body: Land or refine the linked PR so CLI callers receive `LANE_WAIT_EXCEEDED` details and a maintainer-approved exit code while non-CLI calls keep the existing queue behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history ties this person to the agent CLI Gateway relay and queue hardening, making them the best available routing owner for the CLI contract choice.
